title: Streams
explanation: A stream is a pipeline over a collection: filter keeps some elements, map turns each one into something else, and a terminal operation like count, toList or forEach produces the answer.
Nothing happens until the terminal operation runs, and the source list is never modified - you get a new result back rather than a mutated original.
Read the chain top to bottom as a sentence. The loop version of the same work is not wrong, just longer and easier to get subtly wrong.
